reason: My kid's birthday is in the next few months and this place isn't even open until next year, so I can't book it. Even if it were open, $325 is a big chunk of our budget for a party I could do at the park or home for under $150.
objection: It's not open yet and I can't plan a real birthday around a place that has no photos, no reviews and no date. And $325 is a lot when we're stretching every paycheck.
would_change_my_mind: It being open now with real reviews, plus a lower price point around $200 for a smaller group.
